latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of BlogBurst - Virtual CMO Agent.

- Launches BlogBurst, an autonomous AI marketing agent that manages and optimizes your marketing efforts across multiple platforms.
- Auto-posts, auto-engages (replies, likes, follows), runs SEO/GEO audits, tracks competitors, and scans communities for opportunities.
- Supports 9 platforms including Twitter/X, Bluesky, Telegram, Discord, LinkedIn, and more.
- Provides step-by-step onboarding if API key is not set, with full setup instructions.
- Includes natural-language API for agent chat, one-shot content generation, and content repurposing.
- Free tier available; can operate in over 50 countries with 1000+ posts published.
